lead: Apple is making strides in improving AI health tools through user collaboration, while alarming trends in AI-related child exploitation highlight urgent public health concerns.

stories.title: Apple needs your help to make health AI better
stories.summary: Apple is launching a new app aimed at evaluating how users interact with AI health tools, seeking participant feedback to enhance these technologies. The initiative is part of Apple's broader commitment to improving health-related AI applications, which could have significant implications for personal healthcare management.

stories.title: Apple's new research app is designed to make AI health tools more user-friendly
stories.summary: The new research app from Apple aims to gather insights on user interactions with AI health tools, focusing on improving their usability and effectiveness. This study is crucial as AI continues to play a larger role in health management, potentially transforming how users access and interpret medical information.

stories.title: Apple Launches New App to Study How People Use AI for Health
stories.summary: Apple's latest app is designed to study user engagement with AI health tools, allowing participants to ask medical questions and evaluate the responses. This research aims to refine AI interactions, ensuring they meet user needs and enhance healthcare accessibility.

stories.title: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material rise 8,400% in two years, data shows
stories.summary: A staggering increase of 8,400% in AI-related child sexual abuse material has been reported over the past two years, prompting calls for governments to treat this issue as a public health emergency. The data highlights the dark side of AI technology and the urgent need for regulatory measures to protect vulnerable populations.

stories.title: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
stories.summary: Apple's new initiative, in collaboration with OpenEvidence, seeks to enhance the performance of conversational AI health tools. By collecting user feedback on the accuracy and relevance of AI responses to medical inquiries, the study aims to refine these technologies for better healthcare outcomes.

stories.title: High-Protein Packaged Foods May Not Be As Healthy As They Look
stories.summary: A recent analysis reveals that many high-protein packaged foods may not be as beneficial as they appear, often containing unhealthy additives. This underscores the importance of scrutinizing food labels and understanding nutritional content to make informed dietary choices.

stories.title: Are walking pads worth it? We put the best under-desk treadmills to the test
stories.summary: Walking pads and under-desk treadmills are gaining popularity as solutions for maintaining physical activity during sedentary work hours. This review evaluates their effectiveness and practicality, suggesting that even small increments of movement can significantly benefit overall health.

stories.title: All the Health and Fitness Products You Didn't Realize You Could Buy With HSA Funds
stories.summary: Many health and fitness products can be purchased using Health Savings Account (HSA) funds, which can help consumers make better financial decisions regarding their health. This article highlights various eligible products, encouraging proactive health management.
